blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Philippine National Police – Women and Children Protection Center (PNP-WCPC) rescued 16 victims, and arrested two suspects allegedly involved in the online sexual exploitation of minors during separate operations in Rizal and General Santos City. The operations conducted on October 13, led to the arrest of a 20-year-old woman and a 36-year-old man, while rescuing 15 children and one adult male. The suspects, identified as parents or close relatives of the victims, allegedly produced or facilitated the distribution of child sexual abuse or exploitation materials in exchange for payments from foreign offenders.
